addition.item: Adds a global Joomla administrator notification bell with current-user unread count and the five latest active notifications.
Adds a read-only authenticated bell.poll endpoint and 10-second near-real-time polling that pauses while the tab is hidden.
Adds the administrator bell module to the canonical package and provisions one status-position instance without overwriting later administrator choices.
Extends package build, release assets and Joomla 4/5/6 clean-install verification for the new administrator module.
Adds configurable automatic refresh for Dashboard, Notifications and Deliveries, defaulting to 10 seconds.
Pauses live refresh while the administrator tab is hidden or while a list filter is being edited.
Fixes the Core diagnostic to use the canonical lowercase xdecaro Core namespace.
Fixes the Notifications action-column label in Italian by avoiding Joomla's placeholder-bearing JACTIONS string.
Adds an administrator diagnostic action that creates a test notification for the current Joomla user.
Queues the diagnostic delivery exclusively through the in_app channel, so the test never sends email.
Protects the diagnostic action with Joomla CSRF validation and the component core.manage permission.
Adds a CI contract guard for the diagnostic test-notification flow.

change.item: Fixes administrator list screens on Joomla by replacing invalid ListModel getApplication() calls with Joomla Factory application access.
Applies the compatibility fix to Notifications, Deliveries and Preferences.
Adds a CI regression guard for unsupported ListModel application access.
No database structure or stored notification data changes.
Corrects the remaining administrator view imports from the deprecated Xdecaro\Core namespace to canonical xdecaro\Core.
Preserves notification, preference and delivery behavior with no database structure changes.
Adds a local CI/release guard against future legacy Core namespace regressions.
Uses the canonical lowercase xdecaro\Core namespace for new Core integration code.
Registers all Notifications capabilities into Core 1.4 CapabilityRegistry when available.
Exposes the Notifications CoreIntegrationService from the booted component while preserving optional-Core fallback.

addition.item: Stable notification persistence, read/archive state, priorities, expiry and idempotent publishing.
Recipient/category/channel preferences with public service APIs.
Concurrency-safe delivery queue, retry lifecycle and immutable attempt history.
Native in-app channel and automatic plugin-based channel discovery.
Joomla Scheduled Tasks worker and maintenance routines.
Optional automatic email delivery through the Joomla mail configuration.
Standard xdecaro Information page with environment, integrations and diagnostics.
Installable package, update server, deterministic release artifacts and SHA-256 verification.
